description: Works out how many more orders a sale or coupon needs just to keep the same profit a month, for one item on Etsy, Shopify or Amazon. Each platform's fees are worked out at the full price and again at the sale price: percentage fees fall with the price and fixed fees stay (Etsy's listing and processing fees, Shopify's 30¢), so the answer is extra orders = kept at full price ÷ kept on sale − 1. On Amazon the sale is a coupon plus the 2.5% coupon fee (third-party estimate); Amazon's public pages don't state whether the referral fee is on the price before or after the coupon, so both readings are returned. It fits a seller who asks whether 25% off is worth it, how many more sales a discount needs, or whether to join a sales event. Takes the platform, the item price, the discount percent, materials and label; optionally shipping charged, packaging ($1 typical, flagged), orders a month, and the platform's own field: Etsy Offsite Ads, Shopify plan, Amazon category and fulfillment fee. Returns one order at full price and on sale (price, each fee, costs, kept), the fee change, the extra orders needed and, with orders a month, the orders needed and what the sale costs if orders don't rise. When the sale price keeps nothing, it says no number of orders makes the sale pay. US dollars; dated rates with sources. Free, no sign-in. Takes numbers only; nothing is stored.

category.description: Amazon only: the referral category, or not-sure. Left out: Everything Else (15%), flagged.

discountPercent.description: The discount, as a percent from 1 to 90 (25 is 25% off). It comes off the item price only.

fulfillmentFee.description: Amazon only: the FBA fee per unit (Fee Preview) when Amazon ships it, US dollars. It stays the same on sale. Left out: 0 (the seller ships), flagged.

itemPrice.description: The item's full price, US dollars, before shipping and before the discount.

labelCost.description: The shipping label per order, US dollars (0 if Amazon ships it).

materials.description: Materials or product cost per item, US dollars (Amazon: landed cost).

offsiteAds.description: Etsy only: do these orders come from an Offsite Ad? none, or the shop's rate: 12-percent (past $10,000 in any 12 months) or 15-percent. Left out: none (no Offsite Ads fee). off is taken as none.

ordersPerMonth.description: Optional: orders a month at full price now, a whole number. Adds the orders needed a month and what the sale costs if orders don't rise.

packaging.description: Packaging per order in US dollars, or mailer (about $1), box (about $3) or not-sure. Left out: $1, a weakly sourced typical figure, flagged as a default.

shippingCharged.description: What the buyer pays for shipping, US dollars (0 if free). The discount doesn't touch it. Default 0.

shopifyPlan.description: Shopify only: the plan, which sets the Shopify Payments card rate. Left out: basic, flagged.

name: sellerprofit_sale_breakeven

isDefault.description: True when the value isn't the seller's own number or tap: a default their own figure would replace.

discountAmount.description: What comes off the item price, US dollars.

extraOrdersShare.description: timesAsMany − 1, a fraction (0.93 is 93% more orders). Null when no number works.

feeChange.description: Fees on sale − fees at full price, US dollars: below 0 when fees fall with the price (Etsy, Shopify), above 0 when the coupon fee adds more (Amazon).

full.description: One order at the full price.

estimate.description: True when the fee rests on a third-party figure (Amazon's coupon fee).

how.description: The working in words a person can redo, such as "6.5% × $40.00".

kept.description: Order total − fees − costs: the profit on one order. Negative is a loss.

keptLess.description: Kept at full price − kept on sale, per order: the discount less the fees that fall (plus Amazon's coupon fee).

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

costIfOrdersHold.description: profitNow − profitIfOrdersHold: what the sale costs a month if orders don't rise.

ordersNeeded.description: ordersNow × timesAsMany, rounded up to a whole order. Null when no number works.

profitAtOrdersNeeded.description: ordersNeeded × kept on sale: at least profitNow.

profitIfOrdersHold.description: ordersNow × kept on sale: the month if the sale brings no extra orders.

notes.description: What the math assumes and leaves out, in plain words.

ordersFor100.description: Orders needed on sale for every 100 orders now, rounded up.

rates.description: Which rules the numbers use, as of when, and where they come from.

asOf.description: The day the platform's fee table was last checked against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimatesLine.description: Amazon only: which figures are estimates (FBA, storage, returns and the rest depend on the size and stock Amazon measures). Say so when citing them.

recheckBy.description: The day the table is due for its next check.

extraOrdersShare.description: timesAsMany − 1, a fraction. Null when no number works.

feeChange.description: Fees on sale − fees at full price, US dollars, in this reading.

keptLess.description: Kept at full price − kept on sale, per order, in this reading.

month.description: With ordersPerMonth only; ordersNow and profitNow are the same as in month.

sale.description: One order on sale with the referral fee on the price after the coupon (what the buyer pays).

estimate.description: True when the fee rests on a third-party figure (Amazon's coupon fee).

how.description: The working in words a person can redo, such as "6.5% × $40.00".

kept.description: Order total − fees − costs: the profit on one order. Negative is a loss.

referralAfterCoupon.description: Amazon only (null on Etsy and Shopify): the same sale if the referral fee is charged on the price after the coupon. The fields above count it on the price before the coupon. Amazon's public pricing page doesn't say which one applies to coupons, so give the seller both.

sale.description: One order at the sale price, fees worked out again at that price. On Amazon: with the referral fee on the price before the coupon (referralAfterCoupon has the other reading).

estimate.description: True when the fee rests on a third-party figure (Amazon's coupon fee).

how.description: The working in words a person can redo, such as "6.5% × $40.00".

kept.description: Order total − fees − costs: the profit on one order. Negative is a loss.

timesAsMany.description: Kept at full ÷ kept on sale: orders needed on sale for each order now. Null when no number works (see status).
